items.title: Why Is IBM (IBM) Warning Enterprises About AI Sovereignty Gaps?
items.summary: IBM (NYSE:IBM) released a new Digital Sovereignty Index highlighting how enterprises handle control over data and AI systems. The index reports most organizations struggle to provide evidence of sovereign control over their technology despite confidence in their capabilities. Findings point to an "overconfidence gap" that could affect business continuity and resilience as AI adoption and regulation expand. IBM's Digital Sovereignty Index is important context, but investors should weigh it...
